title: %formatDate — render a date with a pattern
purpose: Format an ISO date string using a display pattern.
notes: The pattern is a quoted literal (tokens MM, DD, YYYY).
An unparseable input date yields ~ (null) rather than an error.

avoid.why: the pattern argument is required; omitting it raises a verb-arity error
the pattern must be quoted; an unquoted pattern is not a single string token
